caption: The drawing shows a decorative hat composed mainly of black lace, with a wide, semi-transparent brim and an ornate scalloped lace edge all around. The crown of the hat features a coiled, off-white cord or braid, looped into a figure-eight shape resting on top. A cluster of green leaves and a large, prominent red flower is attached to one side of the hat, adding color to the composition. A long, light-colored, possibly white or cream feather trails down from the side of the hat. Two long, dark ribbons are arranged in a bow at the front, with the ribbon ends hanging down below the brim. The hat is depicted against a plain, light background.
title: Lace and Straw Bonnet
